description: Creates a room: a shared space where people work together with you, and the person asking is always in it. Add people by name or email (members of this workspace); `private` keeps it to them, otherwise everyone in the workspace can open it. `opening` is your first message in it: why the room exists and the concrete next step, written for everyone in it. When the room continues this conversation, put what they need from it in `opening`; nothing else carries over. Check rooms_list first so you don't make one that already exists. May return needs_confirmation; say in a sentence what you're making and wait. Then link it by pasting the returned `ref`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation envelope.

folderId.description: A folder it works from (id from workspace_folders_browse).

opening.description: Your first message in the room, in markdown.

people.description: Names or emails of workspace members to add.

private.description: Only its people can see it (default false: the whole workspace can).

workspace.description: Workspace slug, for tokens without a default.

name: rooms_create
title: Create a room
